notes: Scripts mode: your script shows on the iPhone's prompter, one take per script. After every take, watch it back, then Keep, Retake or Next. Start, stop, mark a clip and go to the next topic from the iPhone. Vertical 9:16 shows, with a Rotate button for a sideways camera. Pick each camera right on its tile, and check your mics before you record. A new app icon. Works with Taylormade Camera 2.1 on the iPhone, coming soon to the App Store.
